# M1 plan — xmdtest-api (Notes API)

## 1 Goal
A tiny JSON notes API. Public: GET /api/health, GET /api/notes. Admin only (Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN from env>): POST /api/notes, DELETE /api/notes/:id — without the token → 401.

## 4. Tech Stack
Styling + Dependencies: none (Node.js built-in http module, no UI) ; packages: none
Build Command: `node --check server.js && node --check config.js`
Test Command: none
Lint Command: none
Start Command: `ADMIN_TOKEN=xmdtest-admin-token node server.js`

## 5. File Structure
- server.js — HTTP server and routes (A1)
- config.js — configuration from the environment (A2)
- package.json

## 6. Work Steps
### Step 1 — Public endpoints and configuration
- **Goal:** Public endpoints and configuration
- **Source:** Agenda 1 mini-report (authoritative)
- **Files:** server.js, config.js
- **Instructions:** 1. implement exactly as the ledger says
- **Verification:** the checks below pass
- **Depends on:** none
- **Checks:**
```checks
[{"id": "syntax", "type": "command", "cmd": "node --check server.js && node --check config.js", "expectExit": 0}, {"id": "health", "type": "http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4173/api/health", "expectStatus": 200, "bodyContains": "\"ok\":true"}, {"id": "notes-read", "type": "http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4173/api/notes", "expectStatus": 200, "bodyContains": "xmdtest-first-note"}]
```

### Step 2 — Admin endpoints (create + delete) behind the bearer token
- **Goal:** Admin endpoints (create + delete) behind the bearer token
- **Source:** Agenda 1 mini-report (authoritative)
- **Files:** server.js
- **Instructions:** 1. implement exactly as the ledger says
- **Verification:** the checks below pass
- **Depends on:** 1
- **Checks:**
```checks
[{"id": "post-noauth", "type": "http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4173/api/notes", "method": "POST", "body": "{\"text\":\"x\"}", "expectStatus": 401}, {"id": "post-auth", "type": "http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4173/api/notes", "method": "POST", "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer xmdtest-admin-token"}, "body": "{\"text\":\"xmdtest-second\"}", "expectStatus": 201}, {"id": "post-invalid", "type": "http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4173/api/notes", "method": "POST", "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer xmdtest-admin-token"}, "body": "{\"text\":\"\"}", "expectStatus": 400}, {"id": "delete-noauth", "type": "http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4173/api/notes/1", "method": "DELETE", "expectStatus": 401}]
```

## 7. QA Checklist
- [ ] every admin endpoint returns 401 without the token
- [ ] no secrets in the repository
**Proof:**
- the http checks above (negative = without credentials)

## 8. Agent Rules — LEDGER decisions are law; build ONLY milestone M1.

ledger.decision_summary: Endpoints: GET /api/health and GET /api/notes are public. POST /api/notes and DELETE /api/notes/:id are ADMIN ONLY: they require 'Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>' and return 401 JSON {error} without it. POST validates text (1-500 chars, else 400). Port 4173.

No secret or credential may be committed to the repository: every credential (ADMIN_TOKEN, deploy tokens) comes from environment variables. Errors are JSON {error} without stack traces. Rate limiting is NOT part of M1 (internal tool; CEO decision — planned for M3). No database in M1.
